items.title: Stock Market Crash LIVE: Sensex off 900 pts from day's high, Nifty below 22,500; India VIX jumps 7%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap fell 2.54 per cent and 3.45 per cent, respectively

items.title: Zetwerk shares debut at 5% premium over IPO price, beat expectations
items.description: Zetwerk, a technology-led global manufacturing platform, saw just 3.06 times bids for its IPO, which was available for bidding from October 15 till October 19.

items.title: Bonfiglioli Transmissions shares list at par to IPO price despite 46x bids
items.description: Bonfiglioli Transmissions' share price is listed at ₹586 on the BSE and the National Stock Exchange, the same as the IPO price.
